probe.title: Jimini Health
probe.text_sample: Jimini Health About Us Organizations Patients Resources Learn More Artificial Intelligence can collaborate with Clinical Intelligence. Who we are Clinical Excellence, Augmented by AI At Jimini, we believe the human connection between a clinician and a patient is critical to clinical outcomes in behavioral health. We also believe purpose-built AI has the potential to create care models with care adherence and clinical outcomes that were previously unimaginable. We are committed to building safe, clinically rigorous AIs that collaborate with human clinicians in helping patients live their best lives. Meet Sage Sage, the AI Care Team Member Your browser does not support the video tag. Sage, the always-accessible AI behavioral health assistant, works with providers and patients as part of the care team. Sage is never a substitute for human clinicians. Life happens when patients are not in session with their provider. Sage is there every day: before, after, and between sessions. Whether the patient needs support and reminders, needs to vent, or wants to practice a new skill they learned in session, Sage is here for them.
